notes.title: 🛠️ Devlog #8: Heads-Up! Indicators & Emotions
notes.content:
Hey, Café Managers! 👋
In today’s devlog, we’re taking a look above our guests' heads - literally!
We’re introducing dynamic indicators above NPCs to help you better manage orders, guest moods, and the overall café flow.

Here’s what’s new! 👇

💬 What Do They Want?
No more guessing - the indicator above an NPC’s head clearly shows what they’re looking for:
[list]
[*] 🧁 Product icons: Coffee, tea, pastries - you’ll see from a distance exactly what each guest wants.
[*] 💡 Recommendations: If a guest doesn’t know what to order, a speech bubble with “What do you recommend today?” will pop up - your chance to impress with something special!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288198/6b6b37e597dafba89a36a4cedba5329a6cfab5d4.png[/img]
😠 Mood Levels – New Emotion System
Guests are waiting… but for how long?
[list]
[*] 😐 Green indicator: All good - the guest is feeling fine.
[*] 😟 Yellow indicator: Uh-oh, waiting a bit too long…
[*] 😡 Red indicator: Warning! The guest is getting frustrated - ignore them too long and they might storm out!
Each emotion level updates in real time with animated transitions, so you can act fast and keep the vibe friendly.
[/list]
📱 Guest Comments in Speech Bubbles
Some characters have a little more to say:
[list]
[*] 💬 Thoughtful quotes: “It smells amazing in here!” / “Just a quick stop - please be fast!” / “This is my favorite café!”
[*] These little moments help bring your guests to life and add flavor to your café’s atmosphere.
[*] Some guests won’t just order what’s on the menu - they might wish for something special they’ve seen elsewhere.
“Do you happen to have matcha latte today?”
If you don’t… maybe it’s time to rush and unlock that new license! 🙂
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288198/5509925e0e5c1225cd7415b8442897724917b1a6.png[/img]
With these new indicators, gameplay becomes more intuitive and engaging - you’ll always know who needs what, and how they’re feeling.

What other useful indicators would you like to see above your guests’ heads?
How about a signal that someone is just browsing and not ready to order yet? Or maybe a badge showing VIP customers who expect top-tier service? Let us know what kind of info would help you manage your café-shop more efficiently!

👉 Let us know!

notes.title: 🛠️ Devlog #6 - Missions & Challenges
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
We're introducing mission types in My Café Manager Simulator – check out what challenges await you! 👇

🛍️ Stock Management Missions
Order Products – Use your laptop to restock your café with fresh ingredients and supplies.
Unpack Products – Once your order arrives, unbox and organize everything for easy access.
Pick Up Box – Collect deliveries and unpacking goods on the shelves.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288198/6077d8039c118681e464553cd47a55ce888766b7.gif[/img]

☕ Serving Customers & Transactions
Serve Customers – Take orders, prepare drinks, and ensure your customers leave happy!
Sell Product – Make transactions with card or cash.
Give Change – If a customer pays with cash, provide the correct change using available banknotes.
Serve Customers Paying by Card – Enter the exact amount into the payment terminal and complete the sale.
Serve Customers Paying by Cash – Count the money carefully and process the transaction.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288198/62b3ea1a8b3d6384f578e2f0be053e3e30d9bcb3.gif[/img]

💰 Financial Management & Growth
Set & Change Prices – Adjust your menu prices to find the perfect balance between profit and customer satisfaction.
Earn Money – Complete sales and manage your finances to keep your business thriving.
Spend on Goods – Invest in ingredients and supplies to keep your café running smoothly.
Improve Café Rating – Provide excellent service, keep the café clean, and maintain stocked shelves to boost your reputation.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288198/a825c6a0361b6fecc406c7d36d3da71dca65766c.gif[/img]

Missions help you make progress while keeping things fun and engaging. Which tasks do you find most exciting? 

Are there any challenges you’d love to see in the game?

notes.title: Devlog #5 – What’s on the Menu? 🍰☕
notes.content:
This week, we're diving into the delicious world of snacks and drinks - let's explore them all!

🍕 [b]What's Cooking? – Discover the delicious offerings at your café![/b]
Read on to explore the full menu – from tasty toasts to mouthwatering cakes and snacks that will satisfy every customer throughout the day!

✔ [b]Toasts[/b] – From simple buttered toast to toasted bread with various toppings.
✔ [b]Sandwiches[/b] – Hearty deli sandwiches, subs, and more.
✔ [b]Bagels[/b] – Classic bagels with different spreads.
✔ [b]Pastries[/b] – Croissants, muffins, and other tasty baked goods.
✔ [b]Cakes[/b] – Sweet treats like carrot cake, shortcake, and more.
✔ [b]Pies[/b] – Delicious pies like pecan pie and fruit-filled varieties.
✔ [b]Donuts[/b] – Freshly made donuts with various flavors and toppings.
✔ [b]Snacks[/b] – Quick bites, including granola bars, oatmeal, and candy bars.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288198/48bb7e016db985f7484afd01476a25452d44af4a.gif[/img]

Each item is part of your inventory system, so stocking up and selecting what to serve is key to running a successful café!

[b]☕ Drinks – The Heart of Your Café![/b]
A great café needs an even better drink selection! Your customers can be served with:

✔ [b]Hot Drinks[/b] – Classic coffee, a variety of teas, and creamy hot chocolate.
✔ [b]Cold Drinks[/b] – Iced coffee, fresh juices, sodas, and slushies.
✔ [b]Milk & Cream Options[/b] – Soya milk, coffee creamers, and more.
✔ [b]Boba Tea[/b] – A fun, refreshing drink for bubble tea lovers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288198/b7565464628e08ec4d8b756626da1b271900bf8b.gif[/img]
